title: VoxVision review
intro: Review a VoxVision result: what was asked, what was measured, and what was only generated or predicted. Keep each in its own frame.

frames.name: Request
frames.guide: What was asked, and the source it worked from: a file name or a record id.

frames.name: Reference images
frames.guide: Drop your own reference images here. They keep their own colors, and on their own they prove nothing about size.

frames.name: Measured
frames.guide: Dimensions and checks that came from native geometry or a calibrated observation, each with its source, its units and its frame.

frames.name: Generated or predicted
frames.guide: Anything a model made or estimated: views, masks, depth, guesses. It stays here until a check confirms it.

frames.name: Checks
frames.guide: Each check that ran, its outcome in words (passed, failed, not run), and its receipt. A check that did not run is not a pass.

frames.name: Decision
frames.guide: Accept, redo or stop, and why.
